post_install: import importlib.util, pathlib; s = importlib.util.find_spec('torchaudio'); d = pathlib.Path(list(s.submodule_search_locations)[0]) / 'lib'; [p.unlink() for p in d.glob('*.so')]; print('removed the torchaudio extension')
comment: torchaudio 2.11.1's compiled extension is built for torch 2.11 and does not load with the project's torch 2.14.1; without its .so files torchaudio uses its pure-Python code.
